question: Which of the following is the state of origin of the Sattriya dance form?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam.**____** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sattriya - Assam**

 
 
• The Sattriya dance form was **introduced in the 15th century A.D.**
 
• It was introduced by the great Vaishnava saint and reformer of Assam, **Mahapurusha Sankaradeva.**
 
• It originated in Sattra, monastery, as a part of the **neo-Vaishnavite movement.**
 
• Sattriya was given the **status of classical dance in the year 2000 by the Sangeet Natak Akademi.**
 
• Sattriya dances differ from other dance forms in its basic stance.
 
• For male it is known as Purush Pak while for female, Prakriti Pak.
 
• The dance is based on **mythological themes.**
 
• Popular artists of this dance are **Guru Jatin Goswami and Sharodi Saikia among others.**
